description: Status of a job. When status is "completed", returns the transcript text in the chosen format plus download links. When status is "payment_required", returns a preview and a payment_url to show your user. Also returns summary, action_items and translations when requested.

job_id.description: job_id returned by transcribe_url or create_upload.

robot_key.description: The robot_key you received with your first job. Required to read or start your jobs.

name: get_job
title: Get job status and transcript
